items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I could help him in line of music and stuff.

ctx.x: I was going to ask some more about Big Eye. Did he ever help you any on the clarinet?
No, Big Eye Low didn't read any music. He didn't read? No, I could help him in line of music and stuff.
He was older than you, of course.
